description: Execute an EOA transaction on a disposable fork of BNB Smart Chain, Ethereum, Base or Arc. Supply target, calldata, optional native-coin value and up to ten ERC-20 assets to track. Returns receipt status, native-coin balance delta including gas, requested token deltas and direct approve allowance reads when available. Other assets, internal approvals and signatures are not inventoried; nothing is broadcast live. Costs $0.02 per successful call in USDC on Base, paid with x402 in the call's _meta; failed calls are free.

chain.description: bsc (BNB Smart Chain, the default), eth (Ethereum) or base (Base)

tokens.description: Optional comma-separated ERC-20 assets to track, maximum ten

value.description: Native coin wei (BNB or ETH), default zero

name: transaction-preview
